pd_sisters_4.summary: Trofimov arrives early, kisses Lubov's hand, and she struggles to recognize him
Lubov embraces Trofimov and weeps for her drowned son Grisha
Lubov remarks how old Trofimov has grown, still an eternal student
Pischin begs 240 roubles and Lubov has Gaev lend it
Gaev grumbles about his sister's spending and insults Yasha

s01057.summary: The hospital barge staff run quiet night rounds
The barge groans and Mrs. Wray tells Ismail she is only bored
Linh reads the cracker box aloud and Mrs. Wray calls it beautiful
The horn sounds Calder Landing and Linh jokes about shore leave
Bronwen tucks Mrs. Wray in and assures her everything's fine

s01037.summary: Sunny slides into Roz and Trevor's table with the codes
Roz introduces Sunny, a teenage locksmith's daughter
Roz lays out the vault plan timed to the rotation
Sunny haggles over her cut of the eleven million
Roz explains the pneumatic tube, her sister, and the sleepy guards
Roz brushes off Trevor and Sunny's what-if questions
Trevor finds the view beautiful; Roz insists it's a job as they toast

s01059.summary: Petra questions Ottoline about the survey as Reginald objects
Clerk Abiodun bursts in with an urgent filing about the ridge
Petra and Reginald both grab for the folder, then draw back
Ottoline reads the folder and declares the ridge was never theirs

s01047.summary: Stranded on the salt flat, the trio watch a speck approach
Dutch asks to be unshackled to shoot; Cullen refuses and shares water
A lone rider stops and waves a white cloth; Cullen lowers his rifle

s01074.summary: Gloria serves cake at a closet anniversary party as a stranger watches
The Tall Man asks if it's a huddle and takes notes
Gloria gets his name and coaxes Bertram into eating cake
Bertram reveals closets are being made efficient; Dez snaps back
Bertram notes the cake and Gloria answers drily about lemon frosting
A driverless toner cart hits the cake box and all four grab it
Frozen together holding everything, they joke that alignment is achieved
The mailroom kid asks about cake and Gloria orders another slice

s01066.summary: On an ice floe camp, Bernadette radios for rescue
Bernadette announces rescue is two hours away
The floe splits and all three dive into the raft
They cut the line and the stove sinks into black water
Rescue One comes in clearly: they have them, stay put
